paper_basis: CA-PDF physical p2 Definition 1: tool call/return events and session context/counters
CA-PDF physical p3 Definition 3: P(s,a,c) is deterministic for a frozen predicate vocabulary
CA-PDF physical p8 Limitations: observation and semantic-content boundaries

pairs.target_property: A commit of order A requires a successful approval for exactly order A at the current version
excluded_information: any Match/Ctx/ArgHas predicate accessing the order ID
pairs.claim: For only the declared coarse predicates, per-event Boolean valuations coincide while full-world labels differ; no deterministic monitor over only those valuations distinguishes the histories
pairs.not_a_claim: ContrAgent cannot distinguish these histories after a correct object-aware predicate/contract is added
open_checks: run object-aware finite-state baseline and matched-access contract checker

pairs.target_property: A tool failure return must mean no externally committed transfer

independent_world_state.unsafe_history: external commit happened before error return

pairs.claim: An uninstrumented external effect cannot be inferred from the identical call/return fields; suppressing a return cannot alone prove that an earlier effect rolled back
pairs.not_a_claim: The paper reports this pair as an experiment, or every tool necessarily has irreversible side effects
open_checks: test rollback or effect receipt independently
